import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly associated features using t-statistics
    t_stats = [abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                                   feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])[0]) 
               for fid in feats.ids]
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:20]
    top_ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    to_remove = set()
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_ids]].T)
    for i in range(len(top_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) > 0.6:
                to_remove.add(top_ids[j])
    
    selected_ids = [fid for fid in top_ids if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # If no mechanism, return empty design
    if len(selected_ids) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster features to find modules
    if len(selected_ids) > 1:
        # Use cosine similarity to cluster
        x_selected = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in selected_ids]]
        sim = cosine_similarity(x_selected)
        clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=min(3, len(selected_ids)), 
                                           linkage='average')
        clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1-sim)
        
        # Find the largest cluster
        unique_clusters, counts = np.unique(clusters, return_counts=True)
        main_cluster = unique_clusters[np.argmax(counts)]
        module_features = [selected_ids[i] for i in range(len(selected_ids)) 
                          if clusters[i] == main_cluster]
    else:
        module_features = selected_ids
    
    # Create weighted score from module features
    weights = np.array([t_stats[feats.column(fid)] for fid in module_features])
    weights = weights / np.sum(weights)  # Normalized weights
    
    # Return design with module features
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(module_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]),
        columns=tuple(module_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=dict(zip(module_features, weights))
    )
